Card Q&A.a: No, digivolution costs can't be reduced to less than zero. You can digivolve the card for free, but you can't gain memory with effects that reduce digivolution costs.
Card Q&A.q: I have a level 6 Digimon with a digivolution cost of 3, and use this card's effect to reduce that cost by 4, to -1. Can I digivolve into that Digimon by gaining a memory?

Card Q&A.a: No, it doesn't. Since the card doesn't specify breeding areas, the effect doesn't apply to Digimon there.
Card Q&A.q: Does activating this card's effect also reduce the digivolution cost of cards in my breeding area?
After using this card, can I reduce the digivolution cost of my level 5 green Digimon digivolving to level 6 when an effect to digivolve one of my Digimon is activated?

Effect: [Main] For the turn, the next time you would digivolve one of your green Digimon from level 5 to level 6, decrease the digivolution cost by 4.
